results.text: Analysis of well-being and 24-hour blood pressure recording in a comparative study between indapamide and captopril. The effects of indapamide and captopril on office and ambulatory blood pressure control and on general well-being were investigated in 30 active, randomly selected patients from 25 to 68 years old, with mild to moderate essential hypertension (diastolic blood pressure, 92 to 114 mm Hg).
